samples.question: The picture shows a grid of 5 rows and 7 columns of blank cells. Above the grid there are three coloured bars, one bar per colour, each drawn in its own lane and covering a run of whole columns. To the left of the grid there are three more coloured bars, the same three colours again, each in its own lane and covering a run of whole rows. Take each colour in turn and shade every cell that lies both in a column covered by that colour's bar above the grid and in a row covered by that colour's bar to the left of the grid. A cell is shaded if at least one colour shades it; the small grey squares outside the grid shade nothing. The shaded cells form a shape that most closely matches exactly one of these five symbols: corner, cross, flag, goalpost, tee. Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
